integrity: Analytic change-of-variables and trigonometric-integration proof; standalone standard-library numerical checker is supplementary, not a substitute for proof. Historical novelty remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent perimeter-uniform points on one Euclidean circle; phase undefined only on measure-zero equilateral configurations. A classical unindexed Brocard-law treatment might preempt priority. The result is a population identity, not a finite-sample inference guarantee.
title: Uniform Brocard angles and a threefold Poisson phase law for random cyclic triangles
